title: Zoro and Luffy Fight Scopper Gaban in One Piece Episode 1170 Preview Trailer
content: ONE PIECE revealed the preview for Episode 1170, showing the fight between Luffy and Scopper Gaban. Known as Gol D. Roger’s “Left Wing,” the legendary character was introduced in the previous episode . He has been living on Elbaph for 20 years, having married Ripley and fathering Colon.
author: Anime Corner

title: Aguri Kurita's Midari ni Tsukasete wa Narimasen Manga Ends
content: The August issue of Kadokawa 's Monthly Dragon Age magazine published the final chapter of Aguri Kurita 's Midari ni Tsukasete wa Narimasen (Don't Get Recklessly Possessed) series on July 9. The second compiled book volume will ship in September.
author: ANN

title: Blue Summer Haze Manga Ends in 5th Volume
content: Kodansha USA publishes the manga in English and describes its story: Makoto's favorite childhood memories are of playing baseball with his best friend and former teammate Shuusuke, the catcher of his baseball team.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s Most Magical Anime Creator Already Has an Ending in Mind
content: Witch Hat Atelier is one of the most magical new anime series that you can check out with Crunchyroll now, and it turns out the creator behind it all already has an ending in mind for how they want to bring it all to a close.
author: ComicBook

title: How to Grill Our Love Manga Ends
content: Kodansha USA publishes the series in English and describes the story: Dating can be tough when you nerd out over barbecue. Kenta, a practical pitmaster, looks for a grill-friend in Chihiro, an aloof and faultless business babe…or is she?
author: ANN

title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Gets a Major Update Ahead of Streaming Debut
content: It’s already been a year since the first installment of the Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle film first premiered in Japan. Following its massive success in the country, the film hit the international theatres in September before eventually becoming the highest-grossing Japanese film of all time.
author: ComicBook

title: Milky☆Subway: The Galactic Limited Express Anime Gets New Short Anime
content: The official website for Yōhei Kameyama 's Milky☆Subway: The Galactic Limited Express ( Ginga Tokkyū Milky☆Subway ) anime announced on July 3 a new short anime titled "Milky☆Byway Spring Special: Terror on Chelovin's Day" ("Milky☆Byway Spring Special: Kyōfu no Chelovin Party").
author: ANN

title: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Returns With New Makeover Ahead of Season 3
content: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End is now in the works on Season 3 of the anime series as it prepares to take on a huge new arc, but the protagonist behind it all has gotten a magical makeover in the meantime.
author: ComicBook

title: Invincible Season 6 Gets Promising Progress Update Ahead of Season 5 Release
content: Invincible Season 5 is currently in the works for a release with Prime Video next year, but it seems that a new update from one of its stars has revealed that Invincible Season 6 is even further along than fans might have expected.
author: ComicBook
